AllowedInboundTraffic: SELECT DOMAINNAME(domainId) AS domainName, domainId AS 'Domain', destinationIP  AS  'Destination IP', destinationPort  AS  'Destination Port', eventCount  AS  'Event Count', QIDNAME(qid)  AS  'Event Name',  LOGSOURCENAME(logSourceId) AS 'Log Source', LOGSOURCETYPENAME(devicetype) AS 'Log Source Type', "Policy Name" AS 'Policy Name', CATEGORYNAME(category) AS 'Low Level Category', "Rule Name" as 'Rule Name', sourcePort  AS  'Source Port', sourceIP  AS 'Source IP', FULLNETWORKNAME(SourceIP, DomainID)  AS  'Source Network', DATEFORMAT(starttime,'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss.SSS a Z') AS 'Start Time'  FROM events WHERE (((((DOMAINNAME(domainId) = '{customer_name}' AND (destinationport NOT IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 43, 161, 162)) AND (highlevelcategory = 4000 AND category IN (4002, 4007, 4012, 4016, 4025, 4027, 4031, 4037, 4039)) AND NOT (INCIDR('10.0.0.0/8',sourceip) OR INCIDR('172.16.0.0/12', sourceip) OR INCIDR('192.168.0.0/16', sourceip))) AND FULLNETWORKNAME(destinationIP, DomainID) <> 'other') AND eventdirection = 'R2L') AND sourceGeographicLocation <> 'Others')) START '{start_time}' STOP '{stop_time}' PARAMETERS REMOTESERVERS=ARIELSERVERS4EPNAME(PROCESSORNAME({event_processor}))
